officialName: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (Economically Weaker Section)
summary: Central government housing subsidy for economically weaker sections to buy or build a home

benefit.displayText: Up to ₹2.67 lakh interest subsidy on home loan

eligibility.displayText: Annual household income up to ₹3 lakh
Must not own a pucca (permanent) house anywhere in India
Property must be in urban area

exclusions: Already owns a pucca house in their name or spouse's name
Previously received central housing scheme benefits
documents: Affidavit for not owning pucca house
applicationSteps: Fill personal details and link Aadhaar
Submit application and save Application ID
Track status online using Application ID

sources.title: PM Awas Yojana Official Portal
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
